hook: Boss ne [[monthly report]] maangi? 10 second ka kaam

slides.title: Raw [[orders]] data
slides.note: Har order ki **alag date**. Boss ko chahiye **month ka total** 📊

slides.title: MySQL [[report]]
slides.code:
SELECT
  DATE_FORMAT(order_date,
    '%Y-%m') AS month,
  SUM(amount) AS total
FROM orders
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

slides.title: Report [[ready]] ✅
slides.note: 5 rows → **3 months**. Boss khush, tum free 😎

slides.title: Har DB ka [[apna tareeka]]
slides.note: SQL Server mein GROUP BY **alias nahi** chalta, poora expression likho

slides.title: '2024-01' vs [[Jan]]
slides.note: Month ke saath **saal** hamesha rakho, warna Jan 2023 + Jan 2024 jud jaayenge

slides.why: Seedha date pe group = **har din** ki alag row, month nahi 💀
